familyAndConsent.writerFirst: Admission committed while each writer was open. In each trial the independent observer saw the original state until the held writer rolled back.

allergyInsert.writerFirst: Admission committed while the F011 transaction remained open. The independent observer saw none of the three effects before or after the writer rolled back.
allergyInsert.negative: An unrelated person received 42501 and committed none of the three effects.
allergyInsert.scope: Installed patient self-report empty-to-first path with synthetic protected envelopes. Clinician create, correction, and content paths remain unexecuted.

encounterParticipantClosure.admissionControl: An independent shifaa_api contender returned 55P03 on f012_source_admission.
encounterParticipantClosure.admissionFirst: The encounter update committed while the admission holder stayed open. The encounter and participant advanced from version 1 to 2, the interval closed, and one encounter.updated event committed.
encounterParticipantClosure.writerFirst: Independent admission committed while the update was held open. An independent reader saw the original versions, open interval and zero encounter.updated events after writer rollback.
encounterParticipantClosure.negative: An unrelated clinician received P0002 and left the committed encounter, participant and outbox unchanged.
encounterParticipantClosure.scope: Installed participant interval closure. Appointment, queue and other encounter lifecycle writers have separate outstanding coverage.

encounterCompletion.admissionFirst: Encounter, appointment, and queue completion committed together with one audit, outbox, and idempotency record while independent admission remained held.
encounterCompletion.writerFirst: Admission committed while the completion transaction remained open. The original versions and states and zero completion receipts remained visible after rollback.
encounterCompletion.negative: The unrelated clinician received P0002. The committed states and completion receipt counts were unchanged.

allergyVerification.admissionFirst: Clinician verification committed version 2, the revised head, and a second allergy revision and outbox event while independent admission remained held.
allergyVerification.writerFirst: Admission committed while verification remained open. The observer saw the original self-reported head at version 1, one revision and one outbox event after rollback.
allergyVerification.negative: The unrelated clinician received 42501 and left the original head, revision and outbox unchanged.

workforceTermination.entryPoint: Core API facility-membership upsert under installed forced RLS
workforceTermination.admissionFirst: Termination committed the ended membership at version 2 while independent admission remained held.
workforceTermination.writerFirst: Independent admission committed while termination remained open. Rollback preserved the active membership at version 1.
workforceTermination.negative: The unrelated person received 42501 and changed no membership.

coreRecoveryRestriction.writerFirst: Independent admission committed while staging remained open. Rollback preserved version 1 and the absence of the restriction.
coreRecoveryRestriction.negative: An unrelated person matched zero rows and left the case unchanged.
